OSF_SECRETS_DIR.description: Folder of the secret files: ref:file/<name> in a sandbox spec is the file <name> in it. The Docker CLI copies each into the sandbox's egress proxy; the adapter never reads it.

OSF_SECRET_*.description: OSF_SECRET_<NAME> holds the value of ref:env/<NAME> in a sandbox spec. The Docker CLI hands it to the sandbox's egress proxy only, as its variable <NAME>.

OSF_OPENBAO_ADDR.description: OpenBao's address for ref:openbao/<path>, as the egress proxy reaches it. Needed only for such secrets.

OSF_OPENBAO_TOKEN.description: The token the egress proxy reads OpenBao with. The sandbox never gets it.

OSF_OPENBAO_MOUNT.description: The KV v2 mount of ref:openbao/<path>: the secret's field value at <mount>/data/<path>.

DOCKER_HOST.description: The Docker daemon to use, as for any docker command. Default: the Docker CLI's current context.
